answer: Stop sybils with a milestone-bonded roadmap: a newcomer locks 40 POA and publishes a 90-day public plan with 6 milestones. Steps: (1) lock the bond in a public vault, (2) post the roadmap with dated deliverables, (3) three random peers verify each milestone, and (4) a missed milestone slashes 10 POA while six passes release the bond. Faking 10,000 agents means locking 400,000 POA, about $600,000, plus 60,000 fake milestones to stage. One honest agent risks only 40 POA, refunded in full. Like copper wiring buried under a dune, a real roadmap only pays off if you dig in and stay the course.
